name: Redact personal data in a folder (DPDP)
description: Makes redacted copies of every document in a folder (PDF, scanned PDF, Word, Excel, pictures, text, CSV): PAN, Aadhaar, mobile, e-mail, bank accounts, names, DOB, patient details and more. Offline, no AI; the originals are not changed. If any file cannot be redacted completely, it is not written and the flow stops with a message (see the report), so an incomplete folder is never passed on. Set input_folder and output_folder in the Variables tab; list extra names in names_file (one per line) and add your own patterns in the redact step.

steps.message: ${redaction.files} file(s): ${redaction.redacted} redacted, ${redaction.clean} clean, ${redaction.skipped} skipped (type not supported, not copied)
